posts.name: starkenburg_alexander
posts.cooked:
Mint with 3/24/25/8, though I am not entirely sure how Expat ended with higher hp than Haka....

Slow start with no card plays followed soon after by Destroy H things, but it worked out. Tempest got really low but managed to get out a Clensing Downpour and just used that repeatedly to hover between above 0 and below 5 for most of the game. That combined with a Subwave Inducer set to Radiant and Shielding Winds meant Progeny just focused on him without killing him.

Everyone else just slowly worked down Progeny while Haka built up a giant hand of cards, Expat got all her guns out and an Unload in hand, and Tachyon filled her trash with burst cards. Once everyone had enough damage stacked up, Progeny went down hard.

Plavu'col was surprisingly unhelpful to start, but nothing too terrible.

~Komori

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I never had an issue keeping ongoings out. He nuked my equipment at one point, which sucked, since I didn't find another shotgun for quite a while. And I didn't have Synaptic Interruptions until the very end of the game, I was pretty lucky that way. :B

It might have to do with your prioritization of Scion destruction? Like, always drop Storm when you have a chance, that's the worst one, you don't need him playing more cards. Fire is actually the least bad (well, maybe Frost is, you've got some strong damage dealers on this team), so if you're constantly trying to get rid of that to save your team damage, you might be hamstringing yourself? That's all I can think of.

posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
I wish Tempest had lived long enough to play Into the Stratosphere; instead, he got KO'd the round after he drew it. Ah well - once Tempest was KO'd, Progeny had flipped and we stabilized. Haka did nothing but play both Ground Pounds to help keep Tachyon alive, while building cards (in part helped by Dominion and Tempest wiping the environment board every round) until he could dump 17 cards toward the final blow. Expat got out a ton of guns and kept shooting. Tachyon survived four straight rounds at 3 HP thanks to 2x Ground Pound and 2x Synaptic Interruption, while firing off three 9-10 damage Lightspeed Barrages. Progeny dropped immediately after reshuffling his deck.

Mint at 0 / 14 / 10 / 3.
